'''Kanawha National Park''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in [[Appalachia]].

==Background==
The national park was a vast forest and recreational area in what would eventually become the [[Cranberry Bog]]. One of the ranger offices in the park was attended by two [[National Park Service]] rangers, who differed in opinion regarding how best to administrate the day to day business. They clashed with regards to what their role as park rangers were and what sort of damage was being done to the park and the local [[beaver]] population by visitors. In particular, one refused to sign off on hunting permits because he believed the local beaver population was on the verge of collapse.<ref>[[Hunting]]</ref> 

==Layout==
Kanawha National Park was a large national park within the [[Appalachia]]n wilderness. The park consisted of administrative buildings such as the [[ranger district office]] alongside recreational and campground areas.

==Notes==
A [[United States Forest Service]] seal is affixed to the Kanawha National Park sign outside the ranger district office.

==Appearances==
Kanawha National Park appears only {{In|FO76}}.

==Behind the scenes==
The park is based on the real world [[Wikipedia:Kanawha State Forest|Kanawha State Forest]], located near [[Wikipedia:Charleston, West Virginia|Charleston, West Virginia]].

Watoga Bandstand.content:
{{Infobox location |games =FO76 |type =unmarked |image =FO76 New Watoga 1.png |part of =[[Watoga Shopping Plaza]] |cell name =WatogaShoppingPlazaExt |refid ={{ID|00260c13}} }} The '''Watoga bandstand''' is an [[Fallout 76 locations|unmarked location]] in the [[Appalachia]]n city of [[Watoga]]. ==Background== An outdoor, covered patio designed to accommodate musical acts. ==Characteristics== The bandstand is situated on the city's outskirts, along the [[Watoga Shopping Plaza]]'s northeastern perimeter. An expansive walkway runs opposite shops such as [[Slocum's Joe (Watoga)|Slocum's Joe]] to the west and [[Drumlin Diner (Fallout 76)|Drumlin Diner]] to the south, and tiered grassy seating areas surround the bandstand itself.''[[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide]]'', p. 499: ''"'''BANDSTAND'''''
''On the grassy area just north of the shopping plaza is a small bandstand with enough musical instruments for four."''
([[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia#BANDSTAND|Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]) Underneath the bandstand's awning is a [[Enola Walker's story, part 4|holotape]] and [[First aid (Fallout 76)|first aid kit]] behind a [[Trash can (Fallout 76)|trash can]]. Stalks of [[Glowing fungus (Fallout 76)|glowing fungus]] grow along the edge of the main platform, where four [[musical instrument]]s can be found. These instruments, including a [[tuba]], [[Acoustic guitar (Fallout 76)|acoustic guitar]], [[snare drum]], and [[steel guitar]], can be played for the [[Well Tuned]] status effect. A standing microphone is situated at the front of the platform. ==Notable loot== * [[Enola Walker's story, part 4]] - Holotape, in the red bandstand pavilion east of Slocum's Joe, next to a first aid kit. * [[Key to Clara's box]] - Located in a [[Toolbox (Fallout 76)|toolbox]] immediately south of the red bandstand pavilion near the small river's shore, near a skeleton against a rocky outcrop. Requires the [[toolbox key]] to open. ==Appearances== The Watoga bandstand appears in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==Gallery== FO76 New Watoga 3.png FO76 New Watoga 13.png Enola Walker's story, part 4 pavilion.png FO76 Watoga SP 23.png ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Watoga locations]]

[[Radrat (Fallout 76)|Radrats]] |robots = |quests = |terminal = |cell name =PleasantHillsCemeteryExt |refid ={{ID|00263415}} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionMTR}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeonPOI}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeDungeon}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeGeneral}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScaleSmall}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeClearable}} |edid =SubMTRPleasantHillsCemeteryLocation }} '''Pleasant Hills Cemetery''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the town of [[Lewisburg]] in the [[Ash Heap]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== A multi-terraced cemetery that once served the people of Lewisburg, it is now thoroughly desecrated by scavengers in search of loot.''[[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide]]'' p. 385: ''"'''30. PLEASANT HILLS CEMETERY:'''''
''This is located on the hillside northeast of Lewisburg. Desecrated with scattered coffins, this is hardly a befitting resting place for the lucky ones. Still, someone has unearthed a few expertly sealed safes for you to crack!"''
([[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]) ==Layout== A trail leads down to the cemetery from behind the stage in the northeastern part of Lewisburg. The graveyard is divided into three descending levels. Many of the graves have personal items, such as a [[Mining helmet (Fallout 76)|mining helmet]], next to them, or are adorned with [[Carrot flower (Fallout 76)|carrot flowers]]. There are also multiple [[Safe (Fallout 76)|safes]] here, two of which can be unlocked with a [[Picklock]] level of 3. Some are already opened, indicating a history of grave-robbing alongside some other dug-up coffins. There is a small mausoleum on the bottom terrace with another coffin and an [[explosives crate]] inside. ==Notable loot== * Potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazine]] - Inside the mausoleum, on top of an opened stone coffin with a safe inside of it. * Potential [[Fallout 76 armor mods|armor mod]] - On top of an open grave with a coffin, near the cemetery's entrance. ==Appearances== Pleasant Hills Cemetery appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Gallery== F76 Lewisburg Cemetery.png ==References== {{References}} '''Non-game''' {{References|group="Non-game"}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[Category:Ash Heap locations]] [[Category:Cemeteries]] [[ru:Кладбище Плезент-Хиллс]]
